==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=EntityFrameworkClassic&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/EntityFrameworkClassicTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=EntityFrameworkClassic&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Data.Entity;

// Verify.EntityFrameworkClassic (EF6): The same snapshot testing for EntityFramework 6: the SQL a query produces, and ChangeTracker state.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.EntityFramework
// Note: EF6 writes the queryable SQL as a .verified.txt, while EF Core writes it as a
// .verified.sql.
// Note: VerifyEntityFrameworkClassic.Initialize() takes no arguments: the model is only needed by
// the EF Core package.
// Note: The connection string in the sample context points at a local SQL Server; nothing in these
// two samples opens a connection.
public class EntityFrameworkClassicTests
{
    // Verifying a queryable snapshots the SQL EF6 would run for it. The query is never executed,
    // so a change to the model or to the query is a diff rather than a failing database call.
    [Fact]
    public Task Queryable()
    {
        using var data = new ClassicSampleDbContext();
        var queryable = data
            .Companies
            .Where(_ => _.Name == "Title");
        return Verify(queryable);
    }

    // A ChangeTracker snapshot lists the added, modified and deleted entities, which covers what
    // a unit of work was about to save without a database being involved.
    [Fact]
    public Task ChangeTracker()
    {
        using var data = new ClassicSampleDbContext();
        var company = new ClassicCompany
        {
            Name = "new name"
        };
        data.Companies.Add(company);
        return Verify(data.ChangeTracker);
    }
}
